Feedback.readOnly.en: You're viewing as someone else, so changes are turned off.

TeamList.description.en: Who works together, and on what.

TeamList.deleteImpact.en: {count, plural, one {Its member stays in the workspace but leaves the team, and the team leaves every project it's on.} other {Its # members stay in the workspace but leave the team, and the team leaves every project it's on.}}

TeamList.deleteImpact.de: {count, plural, one {Sein Mitglied bleibt im Workspace, verlässt aber das Team, und das Team verlässt alle seine Projekte.} other {Seine # Mitglieder bleiben im Workspace, verlassen aber das Team, und das Team verlässt alle seine Projekte.}}
TeamList.deleteImpact.fr: {count, plural, one {Son membre reste dans l’espace de travail mais quitte l’équipe, et l’équipe quitte tous ses projets.} other {Ses # membres restent dans l’espace de travail mais quittent l’équipe, et l’équipe quitte tous ses projets.}}
TeamList.deleteImpact.it: {count, plural, one {Il suo membro resta nello spazio di lavoro ma lascia il team, e il team lascia tutti i suoi progetti.} other {I suoi # membri restano nello spazio di lavoro ma lasciano il team, e il team lascia tutti i suoi progetti.}}

TeamList.noMatchBody.en: Try another word, or show every status.
TeamList.noMatchBody.ar: جرّب كلمة أخرى، أو اعرض كل الحالات.
TeamList.noMatchBody.de: Versuchen Sie ein anderes Wort oder zeigen Sie alle Status.

TeamList.noMatchBody.it: Prova un’altra parola o mostra tutti gli stati.

TeamList.emptyBody.en: Create a team, then add it to projects.
TeamList.emptyBody.ar: أنشئ فريقًا، ثم أضفه إلى المشاريع.
TeamList.emptyBody.de: Erstellen Sie ein Team und fügen Sie es dann Projekten hinzu.
TeamList.emptyBody.fr: Créez une équipe, puis ajoutez-la à des projets.
TeamList.emptyBody.it: Crea un team, poi aggiungilo ai progetti.

TeamList.emptyBodyMember.en: When you're added to a team, it shows here.

TeamList.emptyBodyMember.it: Quando vieni aggiunto a un team, compare qui.

TeamForm.description.en: You can add people after it's created.
TeamForm.description.fr: Vous pourrez ajouter des personnes ensuite.
TeamForm.description.it: Potrai aggiungere persone dopo averlo creato.

TeamForm.nameRequired.en: Give the team a name of at least 2 characters

TeamForm.nameRequired.it: Dai al team un nome di almeno 2 caratteri

TeamForm.about.it: Di cosa si occupa il team

TeamForm.pictureHint.en: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

TeamForm.pictureHint.de: PNG, JPG oder WebP, bis 2 MB.
TeamForm.pictureHint.fr: PNG, JPG ou WebP, 2 Mo au maximum.
TeamForm.pictureHint.it: PNG, JPG o WebP, fino a 2 MB.

TeamPage.notFoundBody.en: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

TeamPage.notFoundBody.it: Potrebbe essere stato eliminato, o il link è sbagliato.

TeamPage.noAccessTitle.de: Sie können dieses Team nicht sehen
TeamPage.noAccessTitle.fr: Vous ne pouvez pas voir cette équipe

TeamPage.noAccessBody.ar: اطلب من مدير مشروع أن يضيفك إليه.

TeamPage.noAccessBody.fr: Demandez à un chef de projet de vous y ajouter.
TeamPage.noAccessBody.it: Chiedi a un project manager di aggiungerti.

TeamPage.errorTitle.it: Il team non si è caricato

TeamPage.errorBody.en: Check your connection and try again.

TeamPage.errorBody.de: Prüfen Sie Ihre Verbindung und versuchen Sie es erneut.

TeamPage.noActivityPeriod.en: Nothing in this period. Choose a longer one.

TeamPage.noPeopleBody.it: Un project manager può aggiungere persone dalla panoramica.
